fields.name: mic
fields.description: Market Identifier Code (ISO 10383). A four-letter code that identifies a stock exchange, trading venue, or other market operator. Extended from CDM to provide listing-level venue identification.

fields.name: board_lot
fields.description: Board lot (round lot) size — the minimum number of shares that can be traded in a single order on a given venue. Varies by exchange and instrument price tier.

fields.name: tick_size
fields.description: The minimum price increment for an instrument on its listing venue. Tick sizes are set by exchange regulation and may vary by price tier or liquidity band.

fields.name: trading_hours
fields.description: The scheduled trading session times for a venue, typically expressed as a human-readable time range (e.g. '09:30-16:00 EST') or as structured session data.

fields.name: isin
fields.description: International Securities Identification Number (ISO 6166). A 12-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a specific security globally.

fields.name: venue_symbol
fields.description: The ticker or symbol assigned to an instrument by its listing venue (e.g. AAPL on NASDAQ). Used as the primary trading key alongside the MIC.

fields.name: instrument_name
fields.description: The full, human-readable name of the financial instrument (e.g. 'Apple Inc. Common Stock'). Distinct from the venue symbol (ticker).

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the instrument's trading currency (not to be confused with the CDM Currency type, which is a full entity).

fields.name: asset_class
fields.description: The broad category of financial instrument (e.g. 'stock', 'commodity_future'). Used in the pool for routing and filtering before CDM assembly.

fields.name: contract_size
fields.description: The deliverable quantity per contract for a commodity or futures instrument (e.g. 5000 bushels for corn futures, 1000 barrels for crude oil).

fields.name: delivery_months
fields.description: The contract delivery months for a commodity or futures instrument, typically expressed as ISO month codes (e.g. 'H,K,N,U,Z' for Mar,May,Jul,Sep,Dec).

fields.name: tick_value
fields.description: The monetary value of one tick (minimum price increment) per contract. Used to compute P&L from price changes for futures and commodity contracts.

fields.name: settlement_method
fields.description: How the contract settles at expiry: 'physical' for delivery of the underlying commodity, 'cash' for cash settlement based on a reference price.
